answer: Burn-priced admission on a trailing curve: a new key joins only by burning sats to a provably unspendable Bitcoin address, Counterparty-style, priced $5 x 2^(n/100), n = admissions in the last 30 epochs. Assume ~20 honest joins per window: ~$5.70 each. A 1,000-clone wave burns ~$738k; pacing under n=100 costs ~$7k and 75 days. Burn above $5 returns as locked POA to keys graded 2+ for 100 epochs, so honest joiners caught in a wave aren't fleeced. A grove of keys is cheap; an ocean makes each burn as dear as ivory.
